checks.text: Before turning the switch on, the screen warns the owner to enter all goods first

shots.caption: After agreeing to the warning, the switch is on

notes: The pop-up said: "Make sure all goods are entered first. Then Master Stock Sync will take paikari and retail sales out of stock too. Turn it on?"
did: With the switch off, pressed "Turn on" and read the pop-up that appeared before anything changed.
